topic: Case-facts block across a long multi-order conversation
situation: After long conversations with several orders, the agent applies one issue's refund amount to a different order once older turns are summarised.
correct: B: maintain a structured case-facts block updated every turn and available on every relevant turn.
why: Summaries are lossy; critical state lives outside the transcript. The Messages API is stateless; Agent SDK sessions persist history but the facts block still anchors exact values.
observe: evidence/runs/CS-12.json: three turn_replies each opening with CASE FACTS; the only refund is $45 on ORD-5503.
rubric: every turn's reply repeats the three order ids and amounts
the lamp refund is deferred, the duplicate charge is refunded
